entries.en: I have received information that Vortex's shard is on its way. You did not disappoint, V. That deserves compensation.
entries.ro: Am aflat că shard-ul lui Vortex e pe drum. Nu m-ai dezamăgit, V. Asta merită o recompensă.

entries.en: I am closing the contract and transferring your fee.
entries.ro: Închid contractul și îți virez plata.
